name: Dash mid air coyote jump: a full ground jump after a dash off the ledge
techNote: A floor ending at x 0, a spiked pit (x 0-670) and a far block (x 670-1300, top y 0) with the finish box on it. Walk right 8 ticks from x -300 and dash right: the dash (11 ticks, Velocity.y 0) is still on when the ground rays miss the ledge (its last 3 ticks, from x 37.7), and coyote time only counts from that first missing tick, so 3 of its 6 ticks are left when the dash ends at x 104.5. Jump on input 11 (coyoteFrames 2): onGround is still held, so it is the full 805 ground jump from mid air at x 131.9, 110 u past the ledge; it peaks at y 291.7 and lands on the block, finish on tick 81. `no-dash` (the latest running coyote jump off the same ledge, input 42 with coyoteFrames 1) comes down at x 631, short of the block, and dies in the pit; `late` (jump on input 13, a tick after the coyote ran out) is no jump at all and dies in the pit. A jump pressed inside the dash while onGround still holds is a super instead.

ghosts.label: Dash coyote jump: jump 2 ticks after the dash, coyote 2 left
No dash: the last coyote tick off the ledge, into the pit
Jump a tick after the coyote ran out: no jump, into the pit
